Monocypher 4.0.2, unmodified sources from
https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher/tree/4.0.2/src
including optional/monocypher-ed25519.{c,h}.

Copyright and dual BSD-2-Clause / CC0 license text are included in each source.
Used for Ed25519 network identities and signatures. Entropy is obtained from
the operating system by net_identity.c; SDL's non-cryptographic RNG is not used.
